Selected work

01 / Experience

Pop Golf
BOXPARK Wembley

BOXPARK wanted its first floor to become known for leisure. I developed the concept, proposition, brand and launch for a music-led crazy golf venue in one container unit.

Today, the floor is built around play.

Concept · Proposition · Brand · Launch

02 / Place

Place positioning · Naming · Leasing story
